contribution_confirmed_evidence_check.name: contribution_confirmed_evidence_check
contribution_confirmed_evidence_check.value: "contribution"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'refunded') or ("contribution"."source" = 'payment_adapter' and "contribution"."receivedAmountMinor" is not null and "contribution"."verificationEvidence" is not null and "contribution"."verifiedAt" is not null)

contribution_refund_evidence_check.name: contribution_refund_evidence_check
contribution_refund_evidence_check.value: "contribution"."refundedAmountMinor" = '0' or ("contribution"."refundEvidence" is not null and "contribution"."refundedAt" is not null)

contribution_fully_refunded_check.name: contribution_fully_refunded_check
contribution_fully_refunded_check.value: "contribution"."status" != 'refunded' or ("contribution"."receivedAmountMinor" = "contribution"."refundedAmountMinor" and "contribution"."refundEvidence" is not null and "contribution"."refundedAt" is not null)

near_intent_amounts_check.name: near_intent_amounts_check
near_intent_amounts_check.value: cast("nearIntentPayment"."amountIn" as integer) > 0 and cast("nearIntentPayment"."amountOut" as integer) > 0
